findings.title: Every internal reference resolves
findings.detail: 1270 relative and site-absolute references checked across 29 pages.

findings.title: Every page carries the Associates statement
findings.detail: All 29 canonical pages state “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases”. 29 place it before <main>, above the fold.

findings.title: Every Amazon product link is marked sponsored
Amazon product links without the Associates tag
findings.detail: 51 of 51 point at a bare /dp/ URL with no tag=shopnow047c-20 parameter. Amazon's Program Policies require the Associate ID as a parameter in the URL of each link placed on the site to an Amazon Site, which is why the published CTAs are gated until an enrolled Special Link exists. The bare links are the evidence citations on the register and product pages, which point at the listing that was actually read. Examples: guides/air-fryer-capacity-checklist.html → https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DKYBTPH; guides/air-fryer-capacity-checklist.html → https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CDY277D3; guides/air-fryer-capacity-checklist.html → https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09B7SB46R; guides/basket-or-oven-air-fryer.html → https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CDY277D3; guides/basket-or-oven-air-fryer.html → https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DKYBTPH; guides/basket-or-oven-air-fryer.html → https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09B7SB46R

findings.title: No price, rating, review count or stock figure is published
findings.detail: 29 pages scanned for currency amounts, star ratings, review counts and stock claims. None found. This is required by Program Policies §2(b) while no Amazon-served price feed is connected.

findings.title: One edition is indexable and it declares its canonicals
findings.detail: 29 indexable pages, all with rel=canonical; 0 page deliberately noindex (none). Note that legacy editions are separated by directory and excluded from the sitemap rather than by a robots meta tag on each file.

findings.title: sitemap.xml is well-formed and every URL resolves
findings.detail: 28 URLs, all present on disk, protocol-valid XML.

findings.title: feed.xml is well-formed
findings.detail: 9 items. Google supports RSS 2.0 as a sitemap format, so the feed is also a second discovery surface.

findings.title: Every register row carries an official source link
findings.detail: 5 product rows, each with the observed Amazon URL it was read from.

findings.title: Intended and observed identifiers stay in separate fields
findings.detail: intended_asin is blank on 5 of 5 rows and is never set to the observed ASIN. Observed values stay evidence; submitter intent stays unknown.

findings.title: No third-party script, pixel or remote font
findings.detail: Fonts are self-hosted in assets/fonts; the only script is first-party.
